components.css: .ds-cl{font-family: Archivo, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;position:relative;display:inline-block;margin:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink,#121417)}.ds-cl::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:-6px -10px;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 100%,#0000 4.7px,var(--red,#D2232A) 5.1px 6.1px,#0000 6.5px) 0 0/12px 7px round no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0,#0000 4.7px,var(--red,#D2232A) 5.1px 6.1px,#0000 6.5px) 0 100%/12px 7px round no-repeat,radial-gradient(circle at 100% 50%,#0000 4.7px,var(--red,#D2232A) 5.1px 6.1px,#0000 6.5px) 0 0/7px 12px no-repeat round,radial-gradient(circle at 0 50%,#0000 4.7px,var(--red,#D2232A) 5.1px 6.1px,#0000 6.5px) 100% 0/7px 12px no-repeat round;animation:ds-draw .7s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}@keyframes ds-draw{from{clip-path:inset(0 100% 0 0)}to{clip-path:inset(0 0 0 0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cl::before{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
A project is a set of drawings issued for review. The left rail is the sheet index, every page opens with a title block of boxed fields, lists are schedules (ruled tables and numbered tiers), and whatever changed since the human last looked is ringed by a red revision cloud. The look is white bond paper with ink linework (deep graphite with light linework in dark), pale blue construction lines for minor rules, square corners, and no elevation.

It's dense in the way a drawing sheet is dense. Small type sits in a tight grid, every region is boxed or ruled, and colour is rare enough that each hue reads as a checker's mark with one job. The UI is read-first: every action copies a mull command or an agent prompt to the clipboard and says so in a toast. Nothing in the UI writes to the database yet, so actions must never look like they save anything.

Rejected outright by the contract: soft cards on grey, status pills everywhere, cream-and-serif "AI" styling, delta triangles and per-row change counts.
keyCharacteristics: Square corners everywhere. Ink rules at 1 and 1.5px, blue construction lines at 1px.
One job per hue: revision red, highlighter yellow, blueline blue, checker's green.
Archivo across its width axis for everything except IDs and figures, which use Red Hat Mono.
Revision clouds (scalloped red outlines) are the only "changed" signal.
Light and dark follow the system, with a `data-theme` override on the root.

rules.name: The One Mark, One Job Rule
rules.body: Red means changed since you last looked, and nothing else in the UI is red. That includes errors, destructive actions and warnings. Yellow means blocking, blue means now, active or selected, and green means done or passed. A new state takes ink, grey or a line style (dashed, dotted, double, struck through) before it takes a hue.

rules.name: The Cloud Alone Rule
rules.body: Change is shown only by a cloud. Don't add per-row change counts, delta triangles or "new" badges. The title block's Revision field and the revision schedule are the only places that count changes.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Figures Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono sets IDs, hashes, branch names, clock times, counts and ratios. Never use it for sentences, headings or labels.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width and weight, not from new families. Names are wide and heavy (112–118%), labels are condensed and tracked (72–78%), and everything else sits near 100%.

rules.name: The Linework Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Separate regions with a rule or a fill, never with a shadow, blur or raised card. An inset `box-shadow` is allowed only as a line.

dos: **Do** use the CSS custom properties (`--ink`, `--line`, `--blue`, and so on) and keep the light and dark blocks in step. A new token needs a value in the light `:root`, the `prefers-color-scheme: dark` block and the `[data-theme="dark"]` block.
**Do** build structure from rules: 1.5px ink for structural edges, 1px construction line for minor dividers, 1px ink for control boxes.
**Do** keep each hue to its job: red for clouds, yellow for blocking, blue for now, active and selected, green for done and passed.
**Do** set IDs, counts and times in Red Hat Mono with tabular figures, and labels in condensed tracked Archivo caps.
**Do** make every new action copy a mull command or agent prompt and confirm in the toast until writes exist.
**Do** mark a table's wide-only columns `.w` and give the last always-visible cell `.nl` when `.w` columns follow it. The final visible column must not be `.w`.
**Do** let any element that can hold a change take the cloud class from `Changes.cls(...)` rather than inventing its own marker.
donts: **Don't** use red for anything except revision clouds. That includes errors, destructive buttons and warnings.
**Don't** add per-row change counts, delta triangles or "new" badges. The cloud alone means changed.
**Don't** round corners, use pills for status, or put soft cards on grey.
**Don't** add drop shadows, blur or raised surfaces. Inset `box-shadow` is allowed only as a line.
**Don't** use yellow for anything but blocking, or blue for decoration.
**Don't** load fonts from a CDN or add a third family.
**Don't** render a doc's raw HTML or follow non-web links from docs.
**Don't** show raw API error codes (such as `not_initialized`) to the human. Say what's wrong in words.
